Our main office is in Plano, Texas, and we serve the Dallas Fort Worth Metroplex, along with the surrounding areas. ​ At Texas Built Construction, our team of experts in design, estimating and construction can handle every custom home or commercial project by focusing on our clients’ specific wants and needs to make every project a success. With everything in-house from our creative design team to our construction operations team, we can manage every facet of your project efficiently from conception to reality on time and within budget. We pride ourselves on exceptional communication every step of the way, as we understand any build process can be stressful. Commercial Construction When designing a new commercial project, Texas Built Construction will walk you through each phase – including planning, designing, estimating, permitting, and the actual construction phase. ​We can expedite your project as we understand the sense of urgency to get things done within your timeline. Our advantage is having an in house design team that will work with you from the very beginning. This alleviates having to outsource design to a third party who has no consideration of your timeline or any factor throughout your build. Our design-build approach delivers a one team, one-method approach to deliver guaranteed results. Schedule a free Project Consultation today to get Texas Built Construction on your team! We will use our decades of experience and expertise to guide you in making smart decisions about the infrastructure design and materials used without jeopardizing your budget. Commercial Residential Construction Texas Built Construction can assist you with all your residential needs, from adding on to an existing house, renovating your current home, or creating a custom home from the ground up – our team is here to walk you through each step of the process. Our services include planning, designing, estimating, permitting, and construction. We do everything for you in-house which has proven to be cost effective and extremely efficient despite the current climate regarding delays and material cost increases. Our multiple estimation checks during the design process ensures that we remain within your budget. Schedule a free Project Consultation today. Our team will inform you about our process and what steps we to take to not only make your residential project a reality, but to ensure the process is uncomplicated, seamless and as stress-free as possible. Residential OUR 3 DRIVING FORCES 01/ Integrity | Quality | Communication These three simple principles have catapulted Texas Built Construction into becoming our clients’ preferred construction partner. We have never had a project we couldn’t handle; we have never left a project un-finished, and we have always exceeded our clients’ expectations. 02/ Private Sector Markets Texas Built Construction is a full-scale general contractor that specializes in the private sector. We don’t just specialize in one market. Our markets include a varying portfolio such as retail, restaurant, office, co-working, industrial, flex, medical, and land development. Having a diverse portfolio has set us apart from our competitors. 03/ Estimating Like No Other The core of our company is built upon a base understanding of how flawed the estimating system is in modern construction; a system in which clients can become frustrated with having to unexpectedly pay more after their build has already started. Accurate estimating is the reason why projects exist, specific contractors are chosen, and how genuine relationships are built. This is why we provide estimates with strict guidelines and detailed transparent practices. Project Consultation Tell us About Your Project Client Spotlight Texas Built Construction utilizes the BuilderTrend software in order to give clients instant updates on their project. The software allows for instant communicate between clients, project team members and those in the field completing job duties. Get photos of the work during all phases of the construction process, see calendar dates for when each discipline is schedule to work, and confirm your furniture selections with an easy and intuitive interface that is accessible anywhere and anytime! LOOKING TO WORK WITH THE BEST AND JOIN OUR TEAM? We are always interested in expanding our team when presented with a strong dedicated candidate. We cannot continue on our path to be the best in the industry without the continuation of employing and working with the best. reviews.text: The men with Texas Built Construction were fast, kind, and completely professional in all aspects of the process. I was so appreciative of their attention to detail and time management. My husband and I both got to know the people that they brought in to do the tile work (which was PERFECT) and our ceiling which had damage due to an old speaker which needed to be taken out. They did SO much to help to keep the character of our home while still updating and managing our requests swiftly. reviews.text: We had a new Trex deck built.  The initial consultation was thorough, the price was reasonable, and we met Brian Jackson who was to become our project manager. Rhonda wanted quality constructed curved edges at the front of the deck. Working with Brian and the sub, the project was completed 2 days ahead of schedule, looks far better than we imagined and was constructed using quality Trex decking board- Spiced Rum.    Brian helped us work through several issues and Nick suggested some wonderful Trex lighting that added the final touch. The lighting is working great and provides a great safety measure to us and our visitors.  We highly recommend this company for decking projects. Again, communications throughout the project and focus on quality work resulted in our being very satisfied with the final project.

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The 5-star reviews are detailed, varied, and credible. The negative reviews are either very old (4 years) or recent but empty (1-star with no text), which weakens their credibility. The company has a long track record and high ratings across platforms.

Some 5-star reviews are generic but not conclusively fake
authentic_signals: Specific project details in 5-star reviews (Murphy bed, dive shop, retreat center, family home)
Varied writing styles and specific outcomes
Long business history (20 years) with BBB A+ accreditation
Positive Glassdoor employee reviews suggest a functional company
